blocks.source: Source: MLS® data from the Greater Vancouver REALTORS® and the Fraser Valley Real Estate Board, compiled by SnapStats®. Rank counts only communities with at least ten homes listed. Falling listings with steady sales mean homes are being absorbed faster; rising listings with steady sales mean more choice for buyers. A sellers’ best bet is a community where homes sell quickly against the number listed; a buyers’ best bet is the reverse. Sales ratio is homes sold divided by homes listed. On the reports’ own scale under 12% is a buyers’ market, 12% to 20% is balanced and over 20% is a sellers’ market. With fewer than ten homes listed, one sale moves the ratio a long way, so treat it as a rough signal.

blocks.text: Condo buildings in County Line Glen Valley
It is not in Abbotsford.
Where it sits and what to know here

items.t: County Line Glen Valley is one of eleven Langley sub-areas in the September 2026 SnapStats data — Aldergrove, Brookswood, Campbell Valley, County Line Glen Valley, Fort Langley, Langley City, Murrayville, Otter District, Salmon River, Walnut Grove and Willoughby Heights.
Municipal geography: the Township of Langley, in the rural northeast/east of the Township toward the Abbotsford border.

County Line Glen Valley is the only Langley sub-area with zero detached inventory in September 2026, and jointly (with Campbell Valley and Otter District) one of three with zero attached inventory. The eleven sub-area rows sum to the community totals in both splits.
The two figures are different instruments at different dates — a September board snapshot against a live November MLS feed — and neither is corrected from the other here.
Schools: Langley is School District 35; catchments are address-based.
The community hospital for Langley is Langley Memorial Hospital, 22051 Fraser Highway (Fraser Health).

ALR residences cannot be stratified — the rule that leads this section: On land in the Agricultural Land Reserve, a residence cannot be turned into strata lots (ALC Bulletin 09 s. 6; Strata Property Act s. 239; Agricultural Land Commission Act s. 21(1)). The ALR frame governs any parcel in the Reserve, which is the first check on this sub-area's acreage stock: land in the ALR may generally have no more than one residence per parcel; a principal residence may be up to 500 m² total floor area; one additional detached residence may be permitted of up to 90 m² on parcels of 40 ha or less, or up to 186 m² on parcels over 40 ha; a secondary suite is permitted only inside the principal residence and only where local bylaws allow it.

Township SSMUH: the Township of Langley adopted Bylaw No. 6020 on November 18, 2024, allowing 3 units on lots of 280 m² or less and 4 units on lots between 280 m² and 4,050 m², subject to eligibility (inside the Urban Containment Boundary, connected to municipal water and sewer, no heritage designation, not in a Transit Oriented Area); lots over 4,050 m² are not eligible, and Bylaw 6020 has no six-unit transit tier.

GST and taxes on an acreage purchase: 5% GST applies to new construction, not resales — this sub-area's stock is resale acreage product. The First-Time Home Buyers' GST/HST Rebate (Bill C-4) rebates 100% of GST up to a $1 million price (maximum $50,000), phasing out to $1.5 million, for agreements signed on or after March 20, 2025 and before 2031; CRA's Excise and GST/HST News No. 122 states Bill C-4 received Royal Assent on March 13, 2026. The older GST New Housing Rebate (36%, maximum $6,300, $350,000–$450,000 phase-out) still exists.

The address says Langley, the search results say Abbotsford — and both will mislead you if you stop there. This sub-area adjoins Abbotsford, so Abbotsford's condo buildings surface in the same searches, but every Abbotsford complex is in a different municipality, under a different zoning bylaw (Abbotsford No. 2400-2014 versus Township No. 2500) and a different tax notice.

This is the only Langley sub-area with zero detached snapshot inventory in September 2026, and jointly (with Campbell Valley and Otter District) one of three with zero attached inventory — checked against all eleven sub-areas. A parcel-by-parcel market with months like that has no sub-area median or pace figure to anchor on; SnapStats publishes medians at community level only.

The Township's own suite documents disagree with each other. The January 2025 secondary-suites guide and the July 2025 Zoning Bylaw s. 102 definition conflict on suites in townhouses and rowhouses. Anyone quoting the guide on an attached-home suite question in the Township is quoting the older, superseded-on-this-point document — and the same conflict matters if a Glen Valley buyer later buys attached product elsewhere in the Township.

A decommissioned suite is disclosed in this sub-area's own feed. One first-page card states its suite was decommissioned by the Township — a reminder, in the sellers' own listing text, that suite legality here is enforced and document-based, not assumed from a floor plan or a listing photo.

Second dwellings are the recurring pitch, and the ALR is the recurring limit. In-law suites, second homes, a mobile home as a second dwelling, guest suites over barns and large shops appear across the first-page cards — and on ALR parcels every one of them runs into the same frame: a 500 m² principal-residence cap, a suite only inside the principal residence, and a 90 m² / 186 m² cap on an additional residence.
The listing feed and the September 2026 market snapshot show different numbers because they measure different things on different dates. Quote either figure only with its date and source.

BC Assessment farm classification — the full three-tier thresholds: A producing farm must meet minimum gross income at farm-gate prices: $2,500 where the farm operation is 0.8 ha to 4 ha; $2,500 plus 5% of the actual value of the area in excess of 4 ha where the operation is greater than 4 ha; $10,000 where the operation is less than 0.8 ha, with applications due by October 31. A flat "$2,500+" line is an error wherever it appears.

The Township guide and the Township bylaw disagree on townhouse suites. The January 2025 guide says suites are not permitted in townhouses/rowhouses; the July 2025 s. 102 definition says a suite may be located in a townhouse.

What trades here

items.t: Fee-simple lots are the default (and only verified) form: equestrian estates, hobby farms and multi-dwelling farm parcels trade as whole fee-simple parcels — no strata corporation, no Form B, no strata fees. A multi-dwelling farm parcel is a freehold land purchase with dwellings on it, not attached stock.

Lot character, only: rural acreage parcels (sizes above are listing text, not a published lot profile). Zoning is Township Zoning Bylaw 2500 lot by lot; the parcel's zone for a specific PID is a Township confirmation.
R-CL: Township Zoning Bylaw 2500 s.403 R-CL = 220 m² minimum lot area / 464.5 m² maximum lot area.

ALR vs non-ALR split: no split is published and none is stated. Glen Valley is farm ground and the first check on any parcel is its reserve status on the ALC maps by PID or civic address; feed text (a 66.3-acre estate citing Township-approved plans for a new secondary home; a 20-acre parcel with two homes plus a mobile home as a second dwelling; a court-ordered sale disclosing a suite decommissioned by the Township) is listing text only, not verification.

Second dwellings are the recurring feed feature — and the recurring trap. In-law suites, second homes, a mobile home as a second dwelling and guest suites over barns appear across the first-page cards, and one card itself discloses a suite decommissioned by the Township; each status is a parcel-and-document question under the ALR frame and the 120 m² Township cap.

On ALR land, the ALC frame allows one principal residence up to 500 m² plus at most one additional detached residence of 90 m² (parcels 40 ha or less) or 186 m² (over 40 ha), with a suite only inside the principal residence; under Township Zoning Bylaw No. 2500 a secondary suite is capped at 120 m² gross floor area, one per principal unit.
